title: Grateful Dead Live at Frost Amphitheatre - Stanford University on 1982-10-10
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1/Dolby B) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/88.2k) -> Samplitude Professional v10.1 -> FLAC/24 (1 DVD FLAC)
source: (FOB) Sony ECM-220T -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Fuji Metal Tape/Dolby B)

ai_review.summary: An excellent audience recording of the legendary 10‑Oct‑1982 Frost Amphitheatre show, highlighted by a smoking Crazy > Lost > Saint sequence and strong guitar work.
ai_review.review: The tape captures one of the most beloved 1982 performances with warm, full‑bodied sound that many fans call the finest archive recording. The band delivers high‑energy playing – especially the second‑set progression Crazy → Lost → Saint and a fiery Throwing Stones jam – while the occasional thin low end or flat Touch moment does not detract from the overall brilliance.

ai_rating.rationale: Overwhelmingly positive reviews praise both the musical performance and the audio fidelity; minor criticisms are outweighed, yielding a high combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Warm, full‑bodied sound with crisp clarity; a few background conversations and an occasional cough are audible, and the low end is slightly thin, but overall the recording is superb.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A conventional setlist that builds strong momentum; the first set is praised as outstanding, and the second set delivers a powerful, electric climax.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Generally lauded for scorching guitar work and electrifying moments (e.g., 'Playin', Baby Blue), though some note his vocals were weak and confidence low on this night.
band_member_comments.Bob: Praised for stepping up and ‘saving the show’ with strong rhythm and vocal contributions.
